newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle trade slow at $63 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle trade slow at $63 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow, with slaughter steers and heifers steady, USDA said. Inquiry good, demand fair. Sales confirmed on 4,800 slaughter steers and 4,000 slaughter heifers Tuesday.
For the week to date 16,800 head confirmed including 3,700 previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 63.00. Dressed basis - Select and Choice 2-3 101.25.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 975-1200 lbs 63.00. Dressed basis - Select and Choice 2-3 101.25; mixed steers and heifers 103.00-104.00.
Wk to date - 16,800 last week - 8,500 last year - 3,400
